description: This PHP test class performs unit tests for the EmployeeListAPI, focusing on the 'getAll' operation and checks for unimplemented create and delete methods within the EmployeeListAPI of the OrangeHRM recruitment module.

classes.name: EmployeeListAPITest
classes.description: A test class extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase to verify the functionalities of EmployeeListAPI methods, specifically testing 'getAll' retrieval and that 'create' and 'delete' methods are not implemented.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of EmployeeListAPI using data provided by 'dataProviderForTestGetAll'.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for testing the 'getAll' method, sourcing data from 'EmployeeListAPITestCases.yaml'.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the 'create' method throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForCreate' method throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the 'delete' method throws a not-implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that 'getValidationRuleForDelete' throws a not-implemented exception.
